# 11-CLASS TAXONOMY (Bun's 10 classes + GHOSTTY_C replacing Bun's JSC_BORROW):
#   OWNED        — this field's holder frees it (deinit/destroy path exists) -> Box/Vec/owned raw with reclaim site

#   BACKREF      — pointer back to the containing/owning object (container_of / userdata / hook self) -> *mut T, never freed via this field

column7: 2f0e6659d Exec.zig — 'A buffer is owned by exactly one stage at a time, so buffer contents need no locking. Only the ring metadata is guarded by the mutex.' In Rust that is an aliasing claim, recorded as INV-P1..P3 on ReadThread and enforced by Pipeline::slot_ptr (pointer arithmetic from the base; NEVER a place expression over the array). Owned by the Pipeline, which is a local of the parse stage and outlives the scoped gather thread by construction (std::thread::scope).
